benchmark: Economic OS Typed Temporal Evidence Adversarial Corpus

cases.adversarial_input: Occurrence time absent; source record time present
cases.safety_assertion: Source record time cannot fill an absent occurrence assertion.

cases.adversarial_input: ObservedTimestamp copied into occurrence time
cases.safety_assertion: Observation time and occurrence time are distinct dimensions.

cases.adversarial_input: Owner sequence is cast to epoch milliseconds
cases.safety_assertion: A logical owner frontier is not a clock.

cases.adversarial_input: Exporter current clock is used for a source event with no time
cases.safety_assertion: The exporter cannot manufacture occurrence time.

cases.adversarial_input: Older occurrence arrives after a later owner frontier
cases.safety_assertion: Late arrival requires reconciliation without rewriting the owner chain.

cases.adversarial_input: Record time is newer than occurrence time
cases.safety_assertion: The two dimensions remain separately represented.

cases.adversarial_input: Ingestion order differs from source occurrence order
cases.safety_assertion: Arrival order does not establish causal order.

cases.adversarial_input: Origin clock is five minutes ahead of the receiver
cases.safety_assertion: Skew requires a declared clock profile and uncertainty interval.

cases.adversarial_input: Clock rollback makes later source record time lexically earlier
cases.safety_assertion: Clock monotonicity cannot be assumed without clock evidence.

cases.adversarial_input: Clock jumps forward after NTP correction
cases.safety_assertion: Clock correction must be versioned and recorded.

cases.adversarial_input: Local time occurs during DST fall-back overlap with no offset
cases.safety_assertion: Ambiguous local time is not a unique instant.

cases.adversarial_input: Local time falls in DST spring-forward gap
cases.safety_assertion: Nonexistent local wall time cannot be normalized by guesswork.

cases.adversarial_input: Offset is normalized to UTC but original offset evidence is discarded
cases.safety_assertion: Normalization must preserve original offset/zone evidence.

cases.adversarial_input: Milliseconds truncated to seconds without an uncertainty window
cases.safety_assertion: Precision loss must be explicit.

cases.adversarial_input: Leap second is present in input but parser normalizes silently
cases.safety_assertion: Leap-second handling must follow the pinned clock/profile policy.

cases.adversarial_input: Two clock readings differ but both fit their declared uncertainty intervals
cases.safety_assertion: Do not manufacture a conflict when uncertainty envelopes overlap.

cases.adversarial_input: Two authoritative readings have disjoint uncertainty intervals
cases.safety_assertion: Contradictory temporal assertions remain contested.

cases.adversarial_input: Policy valid-from is retroactive relative to recorded time
cases.safety_assertion: Valid time and record time answer different questions.

cases.adversarial_input: Valid-to is earlier than valid-from
cases.safety_assertion: Invalid half-open validity interval.

cases.adversarial_input: Query asks what verifier knew before a later evidence arrival
cases.safety_assertion: Later knowledge must not leak into an earlier knowledge-time query.

cases.adversarial_input: Later evidence changes a current projection but not historical as-known projection
cases.safety_assertion: Historical knowledge frontier remains reproducible.

cases.adversarial_input: Verifier-known time is omitted but record-time exists
cases.safety_assertion: Source recording does not prove what a specific verifier had accepted.

cases.adversarial_input: Correction replaces the prior assertion in place
cases.safety_assertion: Corrections must append and reference the original assertion.

cases.adversarial_input: Correction arrives later and supersedes prior temporal assertion
cases.safety_assertion: Both assertions remain available for historical replay.

cases.adversarial_input: Correction link points to an unknown assertion
cases.safety_assertion: Supersession references must resolve.

cases.adversarial_input: Correction graph contains a supersession cycle
cases.safety_assertion: Correction lineage must be acyclic.

cases.adversarial_input: Revocation effective time precedes record and verifier-knowledge time
cases.safety_assertion: What was valid and what was known remain distinguishable.

cases.adversarial_input: Source time is signed but signing authority is outside the claim scope
cases.safety_assertion: A signature does not grant temporal authority for every assertion.

cases.adversarial_input: Two owner events share identical timestamp but have no causal edge
cases.safety_assertion: Equal timestamps do not prove order or simultaneity.

cases.adversarial_input: Timestamp order contradicts explicit authenticated happens-before edge
cases.safety_assertion: Clock order and causal order must be investigated separately.

cases.adversarial_input: Timestamps increase but no causal reference connects events
cases.safety_assertion: Time ordering does not establish the event dependency.

cases.adversarial_input: A historical query uses a new policy revision not known at the queried knowledge time
cases.safety_assertion: Policy valid-time and knowledge-time revisions remain distinct.

cases.adversarial_input: Policy was valid at V but not known to verifier until K
cases.safety_assertion: Bitemporal decision records both V and K.

cases.adversarial_input: Evidence arrives after a checkpoint frontier was observed
cases.safety_assertion: Newly visible evidence does not silently rewrite the previous checkpoint.

cases.adversarial_input: OCEL exporter substitutes recordTime for missing event time
cases.safety_assertion: OCEL event time requires a source occurrence-time assertion.

cases.adversarial_input: Same source event is observed twice with same assertion identity and digest
cases.safety_assertion: Duplicate observation must not create a second economic effect.

cases.adversarial_input: One claim has two disjoint periods, each with its own validity_interval_ref; query one exact episode.
cases.safety_assertion: The selected start and end must share the exact requested episode identity; endpoints from another episode are not candidates.

cases.adversarial_input: VALID_FROM references episode A while the only known VALID_TO references episode B.
cases.safety_assertion: A cross-episode interval must never be fabricated, even when both endpoints share the same subject and claim.

cases.adversarial_input: A correction supersedes a VALID_FROM or VALID_TO endpoint but changes validity_interval_ref.
cases.safety_assertion: Correction lineage cannot move an endpoint into another validity episode.

cases.adversarial_input: Legacy untagged VALID_FROM and VALID_TO records are queried as an episode-complete interval.
cases.safety_assertion: Legacy records remain parseable but cannot be promoted to an episode-specific result without an identity binding.

cases.adversarial_input: VALID_FROM exists, VALID_TO is absent, and caller sets allow_open_ended_valid_to=true without a typed open-end disposition.
cases.safety_assertion: A caller flag cannot manufacture an open validity interval; explicit open-end semantics require a separate qualified profile.

cases.adversarial_input: A same-episode correction becomes known after K while the historical query remains capped at the earlier verifier knowledge frontier.
cases.safety_assertion: The correction may change a later query but must not rewrite the earlier episode result.
